SELECT
LAH.FORACID	AS	AccountID
,LAH.ORGKEY	AS	CustomerID
,NULL	AS	EntityCIF
,LAH.ORGKEY	AS	FCBSCIF
,LAH.AAS_BANK_ID	AS	BankCode
,LAH.SOL_ID	AS	BranchCode
,LAH.BRANCH_NAME	AS	BranchName
,LAH.AREA	AS	Area
,LAH.REGION	AS	Region
,LAH.AAS_SOURCE_CODE	AS	Source
,LAH.PRODUCT_GROUP_DID	AS	ProductGrouping
,PROD.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION	AS	ProductType
,CONCAT(LAH.PRODUCT_GROUP_DID,'-',PROD.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION)	AS	ProductDetails
,LAH.ACCT_OPN_DATE	AS	OpenedDate
,LAH.RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP	AS	RelationshipExposure_Full
,NULL	AS	RelationshipExposure_Prorated
,LAH.BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP	AS	DueForTheMonth_Full
,NULL	AS	DueForTheMonth_Prorated
,LAH.CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP	AS	CreditLimit_Full
,NULL	AS	CreditLimit_Prorated
,CTL.CRM_DATE	AS	BusinessDate
,CTL.CRM_DATE	AS	LastUpdatedDate
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY LAH.FORACID)	AS	AccountKey
FROM eds.EDS_CTL_CI_20240618 CTL
    INNER JOIN eds.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_CI_20240618 LAH
        ON CTL.CRM_DATE = LAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE
            AND LAH.AAS_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
            AND LAH.FORACID IS NOT NULL
            AND SUBSTRING(LAH.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
    LEFT JOIN eds.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING PROD
        ON LAH.GAM_SCHM_CODE = PROD.PRODUCT_TYPE
        AND LAH.GAM_BANK_ID = PROD.BANK_CODE
        AND LAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN PROD.SCD_START_DATE AND PROD.SCD_END_DATE;
